description: This file defines a PHP interface 'ValueYModifiable' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\FilterField'. It specifies a contract for classes to implement the 'yValueModifier' method, which is intended to process a 'y' value before persisting it.

classes.name: ValueYModifiable
classes.description: An interface that requires implementing classes to define the 'yValueModifier' method for modifying 'y' values before storage.

methods.name: yValueModifier
methods.description: Defines how to modify or process the 'y' value before persisting. Accepts a nullable string and returns a nullable string.
